text.text_excerpt: Unexpectedly found this place while walking around (not sober). From what I remember, it was a very friendly group of people and the drinks were fairly priced. The security guard had the cutest baby pit bull so I instantly knew I was giving it 5 stars. I've seen Coyote Ugly and they actually will let you dance on the counter if you want too. I wasn't feeling pretty enough but it's a good time, give it a try.

Look, as I walked into this place for the first time I was mentally composing the review I was going to give just savaging this place...I didn't want to walk in in the first place but the friends (read, the lovelys) I was with wanted to hit it... However, on the night and at the time (October 6, 8ish) it was a cool experience...not too crowded with the early crowd...the redhead behind the bar was trying a little too hard to fire up the place but seriously I can never be too pissed at a redhead....overall the girls behind the bar were cool and funny and handled their business... They have Guiness on tap (That's a star right there) if they had Harp or Smithwick on tap that woulda been an ex...

I think one of my favorite things about this Coyote Ugly is that it's not on Bourbon St. Being from New Orleans and not liking big crowds don't go together very well which is why I love this place. It only seems to get tourist that discover there are other streets besides Bourbon to take a stroll down! The new staff I've noticed is a lot better then the girls two-three years ago. I like the atmosphere and I love being there when a bridal party strolls in!! Don't let the music keep you away just get control of the jukebox that's what we usually do cause some people just can't pick music!! ugh! lol
